shortDescription: An Argentine court opened charges against executives of oil companies operating in the Falkland Islands on Tuesday, newspaper Clarin reported.According to the outlet, the companies involved are Israel's Navitas Petroleum TASE:NVPT and U.K.-based Rockhopper Exploration LSE:RKH.
